diagnosis: The endpoint queries a legal contract by contract_id and returns the list of negotiation revision summaries and author email addresses. It performs no check to ensure that current_user's organization is either the originator or counterparty of the contract, allowing outside parties to inspect proprietary negotiation histories.
exploit_request:
GET /contracts/65a901e14920b721e04199c2/revisions HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.enterprisegovernance.com
Authorization: Bearer <authenticated_jwt>
